title: Multiple Insulin types as a treatment don't work.
symptom: When entering a Lantus treatment in the most recent nightly build of xDrip, the treatment is recorded and simulated as Fiasp instead. Other users report Lantus shown as Humalog, and basal graphing treats all insulin as one entity.
cause: The insulin type selection is reset if you change to the blood test/carb/time screens. Also, basal insulin display and predictive simulation are not implemented yet.
fix: Workaround: enter time/carbs/blood test first and make the insulin dose the last thing you add. For basal graphing, it is not functional yet; developers state basal doses are not included in predictive simulations.
evidence_quote: For me, it appears that the insulin type selection is reset if you change over to the blood test/carb/time screens. Just a little bug. Workaround is to enter your time/carbs/blood test first and make the insulin dose the last thing you add.
